settings.heading: Salsa x Rebecca's Private Idaho Giveaway

settings.text: Nice work! You found our giveaway questions while exploring the Rebecca’s Private Idaho courses. Answer the questions below — each answer gets you one entry for our prize pack: A Salsa Woodchipper handlebar, a Salsa EXP-R Series Bag Bundle, and Teravail bar tape in your choice of color.
Cheers to your next big Adventure by Bike. Whether it’s Rebecca’s Private Idaho or something beyond, let’s build the stoke.

settings.heading: Terms & Conditions
settings.row_content:
• This drawing is open to contestants in the U.S.   
  • All submissions must be received no later than 11:59pm PST on Saturday September 12, 2026. No purchase necessary to enter to win.  
  • Odds of winning will depend on the number of submissions.
  • Eligibility: The drawing is open only to those who are of the legal age of majority or older in their state of residence. QBP Employees, Board members and their spouses are not eligible to participate in this drawing. All federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations apply. Void where prohibited by law.    
  • Prize Package includes: One Salsa Woodchipper handlebar, One Salsa EXP-R Series Bag Bundle, and color choice of Teravail bar tape. Sizes and colors are subject to availability. 
  • Drawing will be held by QBP on Monday September 14, 2026. The winner will be determined by random selection.   
  • Winner need not be present to win. Winner will be notified via email within seven days of the drawing.  
  •  Prize winner is solely responsible for all local, state and federal taxes, title,
    transfer fees, license duties, insurance and all expenses incurred in claiming the prize. The prize winner understands, acknowledges, and agrees to hereby release and discharge Quality Bicycle Products, and any additional sponsors, their employees, agents, officers, directors and legal representatives and assigns from any and all claims, liabilities, damages, losses or expenses arising from or caused by the award of such prize, including, but not limited to the payment of any and all taxes that are due.    
  • Prize winner agrees to allow QBP and campaign sponsors to use their name and likeness in post-campaign promotions without additional compensation.
  • Prize must be claimed within seven days of drawing. Any unclaimed prize after that date will constitute forfeiture and a new winner will be chosen subject to the same condition and timelines.      
  • The decisions and rules of QBP are final on all matters concerning the drawing.
